title: Agent workspace
description: A full agent turn composed from the AI parts: the request, reasoning, a plan, tool calls, an approval, the answer with sources and a composer with the context meter. Copy it with `semi add agent-run`.
when: Starting an agent chat or run log; shows how the AI parts sit together in a ChatList; the AI doc pages link here.
a11y: Order follows what happened; only the answer text is announced (ChatList), tool and reasoning details stay behind disclosures.
